card_pick.why: Held in reserve only: this video has NO title card (one song, no bed change, every chapter card OFF), so the card move never fires and there are 0 card rows. If Mike adds a card, flip is the pick: slide is BLOCKED (canton), flip is the least recently used Safe move (left-behind, 2026-11-02), book-flip and swap are fresh but need the unverified canvas render flag.

face_glitch_pick.why: Brief: soft, slow, nothing epic, and the sound layer is one accent. The warm film burn is silent and gentle (0.38 s each side of the cut, intensity low); a Blocks Max glitch would add 14 baked glitch hits to a sober human-impact video. Used on all 14 face edges. Advisory slot: canton used it too, see open questions.

melt_pick.why: Held in reserve, NOT deployed (0 melt rows). If Mike wants the one candidate (C32 to C33), the chromatic reform is the calmer of the two melt looks; the spherical vortex reads surreal, wrong for this register. Neither is blocked (canton used no melt).

spin_pick.why: Held in reserve, NOT deployed (0 spin rows). SPIN/3D Corner Ease is BLOCKED (canton); 3D Side Ease is outside the last three videos. Every spin is high-energy with a baked whoosh, so none is used.

face_leak_set.why: One punch point in the whole video (F7, 453.933), so the set is one id. The Soft look is the gentlest leak family; the 0.4 s short variant is chosen for fit, because the join sits 0.73 s before the F7 cut-out and a 1.44 s leak would collide with the film burn. Not blocked (canton used soft-2 and soft-short-8); last used on inference, 2026-10-27, outside the last three videos.

melt_spin_budget.note: Zero by design. The brief asks for soft, slow, nothing epic, with sparse SFX. Both CUE-SHEET candidates (SPIN C11 to C21 at 275.75, MELT C32 to C33 at 394.47) stay on the quiet cross-fade + scale-in.

consistency_check: No card fires (rmn:flip in reserve, 0 card rows). One face pick, hand:film-burn, on all 14 face edges (7 cut-ins, 7 cut-outs); the F1 and F5 cut-ins are one move with the montage and CLIP-61 insert-out dissolves. One light leak (Soft, short) on the only punch join; F1 to F6 hold unpunched. Zero melts, zero spins. Every chart, diagram, card and receipt enters on hand:xfade-scale; every Envato clip and clip still on hand:fade; the 5 AI stills on the silent hand:cross-warp (no glitch anywhere); the C19 run uses its own elegant-promo devices. 5 clip-insert pairs on hand:fade, 12 hard cuts clip to clip inside the montage and the CH4 run. 5 receipt pans are single-scene library MOTION moves, five different ids, no sound. State changes inside one container are comp-level hard swaps, not rows. 128 rows.
open_questions: Marquees: I took NO melt and NO spin, because your brief asks for soft, slow and nothing epic. If you want one flourish, the honest fit is a melt on C32 to C33 at 6:34.5 (the poll narrowing to blue-collar workers, lib:melt-rgb-1, 0.76 s, sound ducked). Say so and the budget becomes 1 and 0.
AI stills: the 5 stills enter on the silent still warp, not a library glitch, per the brief. If you want the usual glitch hit on them, GLITCH/VHS and GLITCH/Invert are both never used.
Face pick: hand:film-burn, the same as canton (advisory slot, not gated). The alternative, Blocks Max, adds 14 glitch sounds to a slow video. Say Blocks and every face-cut row swaps.

F1 and F5 open out of a clip insert. I made each one move: the insert-out dissolve with the film burn peaking mid-dissolve. If you want a pure dissolve onto your face at 0:00.1 (the wording in COVER-PLAN), the burn comes off those two cuts only.

The one light leak (7:33.9, before the word changed) is the 0.4 s Soft short, already used once (inference). The never-used option is lib:lightleaks-soft-5 (1.44 s, slower), but it would still be on screen when the cut-out film burn starts 0.35 s later. Its sound is ducked; muting it outright would suit the brief even better.
Card move: rmn:flip is recorded only as the reserve pick. No card fires in this video, so nothing is rendered with it.
